name: Maverick Boost - Raijingeki
desc:
Target 1 "Maverick Hunter" monster you control; it gains 1000 ATK. If you control a "Zero" monster, the targeted monster gains these effects until the end of this turn:
● At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles an opponent's monster: You can return the opponent's monster to the hand.
● Its attacks cannot be negated.
You can only activate 1 "Maverick Boost - Raijingeki" per turn.
strings: Target gains ATK and bonus effects
